item.title: Teens Café
item.author: office@charleston-church.org (Charleston Community Church)
item.description:
All S1 - S3's Welcome to the Teens Café!

Looking for a place to hang out, have fun, and connect with friends after school? The Teens Café is the perfect spot for secondary school students from S1 – S3. It’s an hour of non-stop fun and food with friends—an awesome way to kick off your week!

item.title: Wee Rascals Toddler Group
item.author: office@charleston-church.org (Charleston Community Church)
item.description: We are thrilled to extend a warm invitation to all parents/guardians and their adorable toddlers to join the Wee Rascals Baby and Toddler Group at Charleston Community Church. This playgroup takes place every Thursday morning 9:00 to 11:30 during term time, providing a nurturing and engaging space for both children and parents alike. We welcome you to come and be a part of this wonderful community, where laughter, learning, and friendship abound.
